About

My Overtime
Your Personal Overtime Calculator

About the App

Managing overtime hours should not be difficult. My Overtime is designed to help you calculate, track, and manage your daily and monthly overtime records easily.

Whether you work in a garment factory, manufacturing industry, office, or any other workplace, My Overtime helps you keep your extra working hours organized in one convenient place.

APP FEATURES

1. Dashboard
Get an overview of your overtime information and selected month's records.

2. Today Overtime
Record and manage your daily overtime hours conveniently.

3. All Overtime
Access and review all your saved overtime records in one place.

4. Overtime Calculator
Calculate your overtime hours easily without complicated manual calculations.

5. Other Options
Explore additional features designed to make your experience easier.

6. Share with Friends
Share My Overtime with friends, colleagues, and coworkers.

DESIGNED FOR EVERYDAY USE

  • Garment Factory Workers
  • Industrial Employees
  • Office Workers
  • Shift-Based Employees
  • Regular Overtime Workers

WHY USE MY OVERTIME?

  • Easy Overtime Management

  • User-Friendly Interface
  • Convenient Everyday Use
